name: Litchfield County, CT
findings: Litchfield County has 684 nonprofit organizations. 320 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 258 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Litchfield County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 26 arts and cultural organizations here list public events, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.
